description: This file defines API endpoints related to emoji reactions in a sports live streaming platform. It provides functions to list emojis, submit user reactions, and retrieve reaction summaries for events, utilizing FastAPI's routing and dependency injection features.

methods.name: list_emojis( pageNo: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), pageSize: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of available emojis for reactions, including total count and pagination info.

methods.name: create_emoji_reaction( reaction_request: EmojiReactionRequest = Body(...), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Submits a user's emoji reaction for a live event and triggers real-time broadcast updates.

methods.name: get_event_reactions( event_id: str, request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Fetches the reaction summary for a specific event.
